earlier_scan.note: Extinct Ubangian isolate of Sudan; only wordlist-level material attested; SIL/OLAC unreachable, no stress description located

sources.citation: OLAC resources for Togoyo [tgy] (language-archives.org, Nov 2025 capture) incl. Gilley (ed.) 2004 OPSL 9 (Bilal, 'The Adamawa-Ubangi languages in Sudan')
sources.note: OLAC lists only Glottolog, OPSL 9, Ethnologue, LINGUIST List; OPSL 9 (text on file in catalog tree) merely names Togoyo in a list of Sudan-only Ubangi languages.

sources.citation: Santandrea, Stefano. 1948. Little known tribes of the Bahr el Ghazal basin. Sudan Notes and Records 29(1): 78-106.
sources.note: Togoyo section (pp. 106) is purely ethnographic (last 12 male speakers, clans, Mt. Lefi origin tradition); the article's only accent remark concerns Belanda Bviri ('accented, with high tone, on the last syllable'), not Togoyo.
